label: nyiso 50 downstate ctgas
definition: (PROBE — real partial structural fix, NOT a keeper swap; keeper stays nyiso-41 STALE-VS-HEAD.) nyiso-41 keeper config at HEAD (de-leaked offer curve, = nyiso-48 baseline) + the new NYISO downstate CT interruptible city-gate gas premium (nyiso_downstate_ct_gas_basis), one-delta vs nyiso-48-head-regate, all years 2023-2025. MECHANISM (candidate a, issue #1344 / B-NYI-1): each NYC/Long Island CT_PEAKER (LM6000) unit's delivered gas is lifted from the Transco Z6 NY pipeline hub to its LDC city-gate delivered index by the MEASURED monthly premium (EIA NG N3050NY3 NY city-gate minus the measured Transco Z6 NY hub, floored 0; positive year-round mean ~$2.7/MMBtu, summer-peaked to ~$5). A rule-13 delivered fuel price: non-firm downstate peakers buy interruptible city-gate gas, so an HR~9-10 LM6000 no longer undercuts the HR~11-12 downstate steam fleet on flat hub gas. RESULT: CT_PEAKER 4.46/4.51/4.73 (nyiso-48) -> 3.26/4.20/4.03 TWh (actual 2.26/2.13/2.84); C1 CT_PEAKER FAIL->PASS 2023(+1.00)/2024(+2.06 TWh, in the +-2.94 band). C1 free-class stays 9/10 (remaining free fail = 2024 ST_GAS -3.39, the pre-existing steam/gas-total under-run, unchanged by the premium). C2/C4/C5a PASS. LIMITS (why still NOT a keeper): C7 (D-1) 2024 CT_PEAKER stays FAIL (off-peak cv_ratio 0.454->0.418<0.5) and C3a stays -17/-18/-15%. ROOT CAUSE of the residual: the LI CT over-run is DOMINATED by the Long Island local self-supply floor + CT temperature reliability floor forcing flat in-pocket LM6000 baseload (a fuel-cost premium cannot reduce floor-forced volume or restore diurnal peakiness), and the C3a under-price is the missing peaker competitive-scarcity / #1344 reserve-RCPF price structure (the reserve co-opt is present but binds only ~1000-2500 zone-hrs vs measured ~3000-4000). Candidate b (reserve/RCPF) EVALUATED: the published-tariff RCPF locational families are already in the LP (energy_reserve_coopt on) and cited, but confirmed non-binding with grounded static requirements (consistent with nyiso-29/30/31); the dearer downstate gas does not make them bind. The delivered-fuel basis is a validated, grounded, forward-reproducible structural input kept default-off; the residual is the floor re-derivation (rule #23, now that the basis has landed) + #1344. Rules #1/#3/#13/#26.
